name: tripo-ruin-keep-01
prompt: The ruin of a small medieval stone keep on a mountain slope, three broken walls about 12 metres high of rough grey fieldstone, an empty window arch, rubble piled inside and around, flat base. Realistic photogrammetry scan, weathered old stone, no people.

name: tripo-ruin-tower-02
prompt: A ruined round stone watchtower about 10 metres high with a collapsed top, one side broken open showing the inside, rough grey fieldstone, rubble at the base, flat base. Realistic photogrammetry scan, weathered old stone, no people.

name: tripo-bridge-03
prompt: An old single-arch stone bridge about 20 metres long over a gap, rough grey fieldstone, a low parapet partly fallen, moss in the joints, flat ends. Realistic photogrammetry scan, weathered old stone, no people.

name: tripo-arch-04
prompt: A broken stone archway gate about 8 metres high standing alone, two weathered pillars of rough grey stone blocks with a cracked arch on top, rubble at the foot, flat base. Realistic photogrammetry scan, weathered old stone, no people.

name: tripo-standing-stones-05
prompt: A small circle of seven tall standing stones of grey granite, each 3 to 5 metres high, rough and weathered, leaning at different angles, lichen, flat base. Realistic photogrammetry scan, weathered old stone, no people.

name: tripo-monolith-06
prompt: A single tall carved standing stone about 6 metres high, rough grey granite with faint worn spiral carvings, lichen, flat base. Realistic photogrammetry scan, weathered old stone, no people.

name: tripo-pass-gate-07
prompt: A massive ancient stone gate across a mountain pass, two squat towers of rough grey stone about 15 metres high joined by a wall with a large arched gateway, weathered and partly broken, flat base. Realistic photogrammetry scan, weathered old stone, no people.

name: tripo-shrine-08
prompt: A small ruined mountain shrine, a stone platform with four broken columns and a fallen lintel, rough grey stone, about 6 metres across, flat base. Realistic photogrammetry scan, weathered old stone, no people.

name: tripo-wall-ruin-09
prompt: A long ruined defensive wall segment about 25 metres long and 5 metres high, rough grey fieldstone, crumbling crenellations, gaps and rubble, flat base. Realistic photogrammetry scan, weathered old stone, no people.

name: tripo-hoard-10
prompt: A low wide pile of gold coins, goblets, crowns and jewels spilled across a flat rock, about 4 metres across and only 1 metre high, glittering gold, flat base. Realistic photogrammetry scan, weathered old stone, no people.

name: tripo-hoard-11
prompt: A heap of gold treasure in a shallow stone hollow, coins, a few chests broken open, golden cups and a shield, about 5 metres across and 1.5 metres high, flat base. Realistic photogrammetry scan, weathered old stone, no people.

name: tripo-hoard-12
prompt: A small treasure cache: two old wooden chests with iron bands, one open and spilling gold coins, a few gold bars and a sword, about 2 metres across, flat base. Realistic photogrammetry scan, weathered old stone, no people.

name: tripo-wardstone-13
prompt: A tall rough standing stone about 4 metres high carved with deep runes, no glow, weathered grey granite, a ring of small stones around its foot, flat base. Realistic photogrammetry scan, weathered old stone, no people.

name: tripo-wardstone-14
prompt: An ancient waist-high stone altar block with carved runes on its sides and a shallow bowl on top, weathered grey stone, moss in the carvings, flat base. Realistic photogrammetry scan, weathered old stone, no people.

name: tripo-cairn-15
prompt: A tall trail cairn of stacked flat grey stones about 2.5 metres high, carefully balanced, lichen, flat base. Realistic photogrammetry scan, weathered old stone, no people.

name: tripo-bones-16
prompt: The huge skeleton of a dead dragon lying on the ground, about 20 metres long, a horned skull, a long curved spine and ribs half buried in earth, weathered bone, flat base. Realistic photogrammetry scan, weathered old stone, no people.
